items.title: Arnold Loyacano Interview, 1956-09-29
items.q: I studied with Hamburg, tuba player

ctx.x: Oh, I played tuba, oh yeah. Well, you see, when I played tuba, I went about it right. It had to be that way because, uh, I, uh, I studied with Hamburg, tuba player, and Hamburg was second base in the Chicago Symphony, under stock. So, uh.
Well, how old were you when you took up the tuba?
